info.name: Companies service
info.description:
Walkthrough of the companies API.

1. Start the stack: `make start` (it also writes `postman/local.postman_environment.json` with the actual ports and the JWT secret).
2. Import this collection and that environment, select the environment.
3. Run the whole collection with the Runner, or click through the folders in order.

Tokens are minted automatically from `jwtSecret` by the collection pre-request script. Every request has tests; folder 5 links to the request's trace, logs and event.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Probes for orchestrators. Checks run in the background every few seconds and the probes return the latest report. Liveness never depends on PostgreSQL or Kafka. Readiness fails only when PostgreSQL (critical) is down or the server is shutting down; an unreachable Kafka only makes it 'degraded', which still answers 200. Without a token the report has statuses only; the readiness request sends the collection token, so it also gets errors, durations and details.
